name: s5-coverage
title: Coverage: a Dealing Desk fill is auto-hedged onto the broker hedge account, and the leg closes with it (read-only staff observer)

steps.text: 49990007 is in SB Dealing Desk (desk auto-fill on, auto-hedge on): its fill is covered at once by a SAME-side, same-volume A-book leg on the coverage account 49990099 (lib/coverage.ts), which closes when the client position closes. The bot never trades 49990099; it reads that account's open positions through the read-only staff observer (role SUPPORT).
